id.description: The unique identifier of the API key

username.description: The username of the user this key belongs to

name.description: The name of the API key

hint.description: Hint for the secret key of the API key

created_at.description: The date and time of when the API key was created

expires_at.description: The date and time of the API key expiration

last_used_at.description: The date and time of the most recent API call using this key

inactivity_interval.description: The number of days this API key can be inactive for before becoming invalid

total_calls.description: Number of times this API key has been used

is_active.description: Status denoting if the API key is active or not

collection_name.description: The name of the collection associated with the API key (if it has been configured to a collection)

collection_id.description: The id of the collection associated with the API key (if it has been configured to a collection)

is_global_key.description: Status denoting if the API key is global or collection specific
